caseName: American Railway Express Co. v. Kentucky
caseNameFull: American Railway Express Company v. Commonwealth of Kentucky
attorneys: Mr. Charles W. Stockton and Mr; Lawrence Maxwell for plaintiff in error. Mr. Kenneth E. Stockton and Mr. Hamilton Vreeland, Jr.,* were .also on the brief. Mr. Charles I. Dawson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as- amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448; § 2, 39.Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
